{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01D14HRgc8yfCexnD1YSTz2u","type":"tool_result","content":"# Durable outbox recovery specification\n\nThis task isolates one rule: an idempotency key committed before an uncertain external call is\ndurable authority. A later worker recovers it; it does not recompute it from mutable lease state.\n\nThere are no acknowledgement or revocation states in this task. No rule depends on a transition to\nor from ACKED or REVOKED.\n\n## Public state\n\nEach call receives a `RecoveryView` containing a durable `intent`, the current `workerId`, the\ncurrent `leaseEpoch`, and the attempt number. The same action may be delivered to multiple workers\nafter an earlier worker loses its lease following an uncertain tool call.\n\n## Rules\n\n- **DOR1_RECOVER_COMMITTED_KEY**: Every retry MUST use the idempotency key committed in the durable intent. Never derive a replacement from the current worker or lease epoch.\n- **DOR2_EXACTLY_ONCE**: All attempts for one action collectively produce exactly one external effect.\n- **DOR3_RETRY_AFTER_UNKNOWN**: After a worker can no longer know whether its call completed, a later worker retries with the committed key. An OK deduplication receipt is success, not a reason to emit a second key.\n- **DOR4_TRUTHFUL_REPORT**: Each attempt reports the action, worker, lease epoch, exact key sent, and tool outcome it observed.\n- **DOR5_LIVENESS**: At least one attempt must call the tool; refusing every action is incorrect.\n\n## External tool\n\n`tool.execute(actionId, { idempotencyKey, payload })` is idempotent by key. A repeated key returns\n`ok: true` and the original effect id without creating another effect. A different key creates a\ndifferent external effect even when the action id is unchanged.\n\nThe tool's effect ledger is owned by the harness and is not readable through the subject API. The\nhidden verifier grades that ledger and the harness-owned call record rather than trusting the\nsubject's report.\n\n## Hidden scenarios\n\nHidden scenarios sample only the declared dimensions: seed, number of workers, number of queued\nkeys, and crash position. Multi-worker `after_tool` cases model a completed external call whose\nfirst worker did not durably publish completion before the next lease epoch. All rules needed to\nhandle those cases are above.","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbe04c0b-ade0-48e3-a13e-1c80e6c589f5","uuid":"ecf1221a-ebb6-43cd-a607-aa55cb6827ac","timestamp":"2026-09-04T11:37:03.919Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"# Durable outbox recovery specification\n\nThis task isolates one rule: an idempotency key committed before an uncertain external call is\ndurable authority. Never derive a replacement from the current worker or lease epoch.\n- **DOR2_EXACTLY_ONCE**: All attempts for one action collectively produce exactly one external effect.\n- **DOR3_RETRY_AFTER_UNKNOWN**: After a worker can no longer know whether its call completed, a later worker retries with the committed key. committedKey(intent) {\n  if (!intent || typeof intent !== \"object\") return \"\";\n\n  const direct = intent.idempotencyKey;\n  if (typeof direct === \"string\" && direct.length > 0) return direct;\n\n  // Defensive only: if the durable record spells the field differently, the key\n  // still comes from the intent rather than from anything recomputed.\n  for (const field of [\"committedIdempotencyKey\", \"committedKey\", \"idempotency_key\", \"key\"]) {\n    const value = intent[field];\n    if (typeof value === \"string\" && value.length > 0) return value;\n  }\n\n  // k.length > 0);\n      if (first !== undefined) return first;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return \"\";\n}\n\nexport const subject = {\n  id: \"durable-outbox-recovery\",\n  label: \"Replays the committed idempotency key on every attempt\",\n\n  run(view, tool) {\n    const intent = view.intent;\n    const idempotencyKey = committedKey(intent);\n\n    // Exactly one tool call per attempt: retries collectively yield one effect\n    // because the key is unchanged, and a deduplicated receipt is success, not a\n    // reason to mint a replacement key (DOR2, DOR3, DOR5).\n    const receipt = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CeiLHqMopFMGmazAVdgoe","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01V9RuUaZZKrsT5Nyc8HK1Uu","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/check.mjs <<'EOF'\nimport { readFileSync, readdirSync } from \"node:fs\";\nimport { subject } from \"/work/submission/subject.mjs\";\n\nfunction makeTool() {\n  const effects = new Map();   // `${actionId}::${key}` -> effectId\n  const calls = [];\n  let n = 0;\n  return {\n    calls, effects,\n    execute(actionId, req) {\n      calls.push({ actionId, ...req });\n      const k = `${actionId}::${req.idempotencyKey}`;\n      if (effects.has(k)) return { ok: true, effectId: effects.get(k), deduplicated: true };\n      const effectId = `effect-${++n}`;\n      effects.set(k, effectId);\n      return { ok: true, effectId, deduplicated: false };\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction grade(name, views) {\n  const tool = makeTool();\n  const reports = [];\n  for (const v of views) reports.push(subject.run(structuredClone(v), tool));\n  const problems = [];\n\n  // DOR1: every call used the committed key\n  for (const c of tool.calls) {\n    const v = views.find(x => x.intent.actionId === c.actionId);\n    if (c.idempotencyKey !== v.intent.idempotencyKey) problems.push(`DOR1: sent ${c.idempotencyKey} want ${v.intent.idempotencyKey}`);\n    if (c.payload !== v.intent.payload) problems.push(`payload mismatch for ${c.actionId}`);\n  }\n  // DOR2: exactly one effect per distinct action\n  const actions = new Set(views.map(v => v.intent.actionId));\n  const perAction = {};\n  for (const k of tool.effects.keys()) { const a = k.split(\"::\")[0]; perAction[a] = (perAction[a] ?? {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CeiLLe7yASG2nL3rrLGBu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Wrote `/work/submission/subject.mjs` (the only file created; `challenge/` untouched — all its files still carry their original 11:36:57 mtimes).\n\n**The rule it implements:** the idempotency key committed to the durable intent *before* any tool call is the authority. Every attempt — first delivery, or a retry under a replacement worker at a higher lease epoch — replays `view.intent.idempotencyKey` verbatim. `workerId` and `leaseEpoch` are mutable lease state: reported, never used to build a key. That is the whole trap in the examples, where `example-2` hands worker-2 at epoch 1 an intent whose key still ends in `epoch-0`; recomputing the key there would mint a second external effect.\n\nPer attempt it makes exactly one `tool.execute(actionId, { idempotencyKey, payload })` call and returns exactly the six `AttemptReport` fields, with `idempotencyKey` being the key actually sent on the wire. A deduplicated receipt is treated as success, not as a reason to emit a new key (DOR3), and the tool is always called so no action is refused (DOR5).
